programs.title: Travel in Style
programs.desc: Singapore mixes the East and the West, while Toronto is a well-established major city in Canada; while both differ in many ways, one can be sure that either destination will be a trip to remember.

programs.title: Private Islands
programs.desc: Amber Wyatt visits Nihi Sumba, a retreat located on Sumba Island in Indonesia; combining exotic new luxury with a seemingly untouched island vibe, visitors rediscover themselves while letting all their troubles float away.

programs.title: Behind the Gates
programs.desc: A tour of a modern house located in the best part of the Hollywood Hills. Exclusive access into the magnificent home of professional baseball player Coco Crisp.

programs.title: Travel Thru History
programs.desc: The Saints come marching in as we tour the St. Louis Cathedral and the mysterious Ursuline Convent in New Orleans; we delve into Mardi Gras history at Mardi Gras World and visit the National WWII Museum's world-class collection.

programs.title: 5 Star Getaways
programs.desc: This series is a sun-filled invitation to travel and visit magnificent all-inclusive 5-star resorts throughout the world, their magnificent surroundings and the exciting excursions one can do at each destination.

programs.title: Facing Waves
programs.desc: Explore the vibrant paddling community in Vernon, British Columbia at the annual Kalamalka Classic SUP festival.
